author: Codex
purpose: Eleven individually authored repairs, not new full-film plans

jobs.prompt: Precise continuity repair. Image 1 is the scene to edit, image 2 its fixed quay master, image 3 the canonical boatman only. Keep image 1's camera, people, poses, fish trays, boats, cargo, mooring rope, counter, baskets, awning, bridge and low distant roofs unchanged. Change ONLY the boatman's trousers to the exact charcoal dark lower garment of image 3: no light grey panels, blue cuffs or yellow leg straps. Keep teal upper, charcoal sash and ochre headband. Replace detailed grip fingers with smooth solid-white mitten silhouettes, at most one thumb bump, no finger divisions or interior lines. Remove drawn comic movement marks. Every exposed skin surface must be pure #FFFFFF with NO grey shadow. Preserve crisp sober BD outlines, matte colour areas and readable architecture. No text, new objects, extra people or new skyline.

Repair image 1, preserving the exact quay geometry of image 2. Images 3 and 4 identify boatman and indigo cloth-shop assistant. Restore boatman's full CHARCOAL trousers exactly as image 3, no grey panels, blue cuffs or yellow straps; teal coat and ochre headband unchanged. Move ONLY the indigo assistant to the street/customer side IN FRONT of the fish counter, facing the ochre-and-green fishseller behind the counter. Do not move the fishseller, rust porter, boatman or incoming tray. Preserve all three existing counter trays, quay baskets, boats, cargo and rope. Assistant keeps indigo jacket, grey sash and charcoal trousers of image 4. All heads perfectly round oversized pure white with dot eyes, neutral tiny line mouth; no hair, nose, ears or brows. All skin pure #FFFFFF unshaded; hands smooth white mittens with no separate fingers. Keep sober BD matte flat colours, restrained textures, crisp architecture and low roofs. No other edits, text, extra trays or people.

ALL skin #FFFFFF without shading, smooth mitten hands no fingers. Same sober BD flat matte finish and reduced textures. No captions, new monuments or extra characters.
